comparison.objective: Use a physical mouse to drag a file into the correct on-screen folder and release the mouse.
comparison.physical_skill: Mouse grasping, planar cursor control, button timing, drag-and-drop coordination, and physical release.
comparison.success_condition: File dropped in the green folder, mouse upright on its mat with button up, and fingers clear for one second; wrong-folder actions, opening icons, mat departure, or monitor contact zero the score. Mouse damage is unspecified.
comparison.reason: This is a physical human-interface task with virtual target feedback, wholly separate from granular manipulation.
